title: finding(metadata-protocol): on an unscoped kernel a stored container's hydrated expansions carry no tenant marker, so an expanded view reads `resettable: true` and its layered `code` is the hydrated expansion
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect, class (a)**: a read answers a wrong value. `reach:` measured in-process at the protocol (`getMetaItem` / `getMetaItemLayered`, the methods the by-name and layered REST reads call), on an unscoped (control-plane) kernel only, at PR #21508's head `3558ad6e70`. The `env_local` kernel answers correctly. It was not measured over REST.

Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367, `session_01DDZNkDVwPQnevTFcYE47H3`), from #21442's os-dev report 5964086824 (`out_of_scope_findings[1]`). **Reader who acts:** triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Measured (the dev's repro, with PR #21508's test harness)

- `showcaseHarness(undefined)` (unscoped kernel); then `saveMetaItem({ type: 'view', name: 'os_qa_probe', packageId: 'com.example.repairassets', item: { name: 'os_qa_probe', object: 'showcase_task', listViews: { in_progress: { type: 'grid', columns: ['title','status'] } } } })`.
- `getMetaItem({ type: 'view', name: 'showcase_task.os_qa_probe.in_progress' }).resettable` → **`true`** (on `env_local`: `false`).
- `getMetaItemLayered` gives `code` = the hydrated expansion (on `env_local`: `null`). The same holds for package-less environment-wide containers.

## Mechanism (read)

- `hydrateExpandedViewItems` registers an environment-wide container's expansions WITHOUT the tenant marker that `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` stamps on the container itself (`stateTenantAuthorship`).
- `SchemaRegistry.getArtifactItem`'s bare-key fallback then takes a package-bound container's expansion for a code artifact.
- `resettable` is `isArtifactBacked`, the same predicate the save door reads for a write by that name. So the producer fix changes what the save door does for a write by an expanded name, which #21442's ruling kept unchanged. That is why it was not fixed there.

## Candidate homes (triage's call)

- #21470 (the save door, every type), because the fix moves the save door's reading of that name; or a card of its own.

## Dedupe

REST list of the 1,000 most recently updated issues and PRs (down to #2714), grepped for `hydrateExpandedViewItems` (2: #21442, PR #21430), `stateTenantAuthorship` (0), `getArtifactItem` (2: PR #20880, PR #20817, other subjects) and `resettable … expan` (1: PR #21508). The control, `view container`, hits 17. The search endpoint was refused by the egress proxy in this session.
